summary: Discussion snapshot: Anthropic Claude Code release and vendor security incidents dominate chatter; operators report MCP sandboxing and agent integration failures; multiple infra primitives (GitSpawn vuln, kassette, sandboxd) surfaced from HN/Bluesky/Reddit. | Vendor updates: Anthropic security incident + containment engineering and MHS preview; new agent/platform releases from Mistral, Google ADK 1.0, Daytona; infra changes from Cloudflare and Modal. | GitHub snapshot: mix of vendor releases (Anthropic, Cloudflare, GitHub/Gemini/OpenAI) plus high-star infra projects (OpenClaw, Moltis, agmsg) and many repo-only agent tools; several operator HOWTOs lack independent corroboration. | Package-only sweep: multiple MCP, sandbox, security, and vendor agent packages surfaced; strong vendor signals from OpenAI and Amazon. Largely single-source package evidence — many items need corroboration or operator reports.
